The balance sheet and earnings profile support a strong investment-grade assessment: liquidity is adequate (current ratio 1.07), leverage is moderate (liabilities/assets about 59%, equity/assets about 41%), and profitability is robust (EBIT margin about 30%). The very large retained earnings base also suggests substantial cumulative financial strength, though the only modest short-term liquidity keeps it short of the very highest rating tiers.

DECISION: A+
